thesis: The speaker recounts his early entrepreneurial failure during the dot-com bubble, attributing the collapse to a sophisticated but incorrect business plan and financial model that he and his team treated as truth. He explains that while his dorm-based startup failed, the Silicon Valley interview process reframed that failure as valuable education, teaching him that he did not truly understand strategy at the time.
